items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: So when my first son was born, I named him Gregory O'ens Tyler.

ctx.x: To the microphones. Okay. Let's see. Let's give me your full name. That's usually where

we start. Alvin O'en Tyler. Okay, because I never knew what the O was for. Yeah. O-W-E-N. O-W-E-N. Where's the O'en from? Is that from a family? Probably, you know, it's not O'ens like I thought at one time. It's O'en like it's somebody's first name. Maybe the doctor who delivered me or something, you know. So it's not a family name. No, no, no, no. You had O'en? No. Oh, okay. Because I've always seen the O-en. I actually, because I've not ever seen my birth certificate, I was always told by my older brother, I…
Okay. So, so we got the O out the way. So your father's name was? Virgil Tyler. Virgil Tyler. And your mother's name was?
